scope: Reporting clarification and conditional follow-up specification, not an amendment to the active scientific protocol. Some paths/pilots were already completed; recorded before final three-history assessment, not claimed blinded.

reporting.conditional_expected_wording: If all comparisons qualify and the old pattern repeats: directional polarity mechanics suppressed initiation in 1/3 tested histories (history 9). In histories 7 and 8, initiation failed even with directional polarity tension disabled, while matched frozen references formed. The cause of this moving-versus-frozen restriction remains unresolved.

followup.eligibility: Qualified carry chi=0 moving nonformation plus actual-input matched frozen formation.
followup.design: 2x2: dilution on/off crossed with evolving/fixed initial symmetric contact conductances; mechanics and chemical feedback co-evolve in every arm.
followup.fixed_transport_definition: Delta(t)=-M(t)^(-1)K(0); freeze symmetric conductances, retain current compartment masses. Do not hold Delta(0) fixed against changing physical masses.
followup.dilution_off_accounting: At volume conversion, chemical amount source per cell is (V_new-V_old)*c_preconversion. Record and verify it rather than requiring zero source.
followup.history9_role: Existing successful carry chi=0 formation benchmark; not a new factorial replicate.
followup.if_combined_fails: First test remaining capacity dependence with M(0), K(0), dilution off and live mechanics; require agreement with actual-input frozen ODE reference within 0.01 log concentration.
followup.subsequent_geometry_test: Same-history no-feedback geometry at the same t=150, lineage-indexed matched concentration perturbation and matched continuation parameters. Tests prior conditioning, not specific forces or fresh carry zygote convergence.
